policy: A source's bytes are committed only where its licence permits redistribution (PROTOCOL.md, architect's note of 2026-08-18). PostgreSQL's source tarball is under the PostgreSQL Licence and could lawfully be redistributed; it is 21.6 MB and is NOT committed, because the manifest is the better warrant: a stranger re-fetches the same URL, compares the SHA-256 against the publisher's own .sha256 file, and re-runs measure.py.

fetches.what: the publisher's own checksum for the tarball below
fetches.why: so that the tarball is verified against the publisher rather than against a hash this night computed for itself
the object: it carries the published vocabulary (src/backend/utils/errcodes.txt), the manual sources that publish it (doc/src/sgml/), and the machine that imposes it

fetches.what: the live manual, section 34.8.3 SQLSTATE vs. SQLCODE -- the second published listing
fetches.why: to confirm that the tarball's doc/src/sgml/ecpg.sgml is what the public page shows, and to fix the section number rather than infer it
fetches.checked: YE002 occurs 4 times; the sentence 'consult the global SQLSTATE listing in Appendix A' is present

fetches.what: the live Appendix A -- the first published listing
fetches.why: to check on the public page, not only in the tarball, whether the seven codes the other listing offers are there
fetches.checked: 262 distinct five-character literals; 0 occurrences of YE000, YE001, YE002, 07001, 07002, 07006, 07009 and 33000; 0A000 and 3F000 present once each

inaccessible.what: ISO/IEC 9075 (the SQL standard), the document that assigns the meaning of SQLSTATE classes 07 and 33
inaccessible.why_it_matters: it would say whether 07001, 07002, 07006, 07009 and 33000 are the standard's codes rather than this implementation's inventions
inaccessible.status: not accessible without purchase; no claim about the standard's content is made anywhere in this work, and every statement about a class is taken from PostgreSQL's own file (F-088)

not_run: Nothing in the tarball was built, configured or executed. The object is the published tree as it stands.
